data.name: NoPassphraseWarning
data.value: No passphrase — the hidden zip will not be encrypted. Many common zip tools (7-Zip, WinRAR, Windows' own "Extract All") can open the attached zip directly without needing this app at all — so anyone who receives this file and knows to look can see the photos inside.

data.value: Share the output file as-is — any tool that re-saves or re-encodes it (most messaging apps, social platforms, some cloud photo services) will strip the hidden data off the end.

data.name: PathNotRootedError
data.value: Enter a full path, starting from the root of the drive.

data.name: FileNotImageError
data.value: That file isn't a readable image.
